objective: Complete all empirical gaps for Task 1: Resource telemetry, batch sensitivity, 30-min soak test, engine-only isolation, tokenizer mutex profiling, and search latency.

batch_sensitivity.description: Baseline (C=1, 100k docs, b=500/1000) and heavy stress (C=32, 1M docs, b=1000/2000), 3 reps each in AB/BA order.

engine_only.description: Engine ingestion cost isolation with RAM pre-tokenized corpus for Model A vs raw text for Model B.

search_latency.description: End-to-end query latency benchmark on pre-tokenized queries vs raw queries across concurrency levels.

tokenizer_profile.description: Pure client-side CGO tokenizer scaling and lock contention profiling across concurrency levels.

soak_test.description: 30-minute sustained indexing at C=16, batch=1000, 1-second resource telemetry recording.
